title: Distributed Performance Boosting through Neural Control for Plug-and-Play Networks
abstract: arXiv:2610.23292v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: We address the problem of improving the performance of pre-stabilized networked systems subject to plug-and-play (PnP) operations, namely additions or removals of subsystems. While distributed baseline controllers can preserve stability after a PnP transition, augmenting them with expressive neural policies can invalidate the formal stability guarantees. To overcome this issue, we build on recently proposed Performance Boosting controllers based on the Internal Model Control (IMC) principle, which reduce closed-loop stability to a finite $\ell_2$-gain requirement on an auxiliary operator. In the distributed setting, this operator is formed by interconnecting local neural operators that exchange information only between neighboring subsystems. translated_title: 基于神经控制的即插即用网络分布式性能提升
translated_abstract: 我们研究了改善预稳定网络化系统在即插即用（PnP）操作（即子系统的添加或移除）下性能的问题。虽然分布式基线控制器可以在PnP转换后保持稳定性，但若使用富有表现力的神经网络策略对其进行增强，则可能使形式化的稳定性保证失效。为克服这一问题，我们基于最近提出的、以内模控制（IMC）原理为基础的性能提升控制器，该方法将闭环稳定性问题转化为对辅助算子的有限ℓ₂增益要求。在分布式设置中，该算子由仅在相邻子系统之间交换信息的局部神经算子互连构成。随后，我们推导了这种互连结构的自由参数化方法，即从无约束的可训练变量到满足规定网络增益界的互连神经算子的显式映射。
tldr: 本文提出一种基于内模控制原理的分布式神经控制方法，通过局部神经算子的自由参数化互连，在保证即插即用网络系统闭环稳定性的同时提升控制性能。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes a distributed neural control approach based on the Internal Model Control principle, deriving free parametrizations of interconnected local neural operators that guarantee closed-loop stability while boosting performance for plug-and-play networked systems.
